storeys.sql: SELECT e.Name AS Storey, max(CASE WHEN p.Name = 'Ifc:Elevation' THEN TRY_CAST(p.Value AS DOUBLE) END) AS Elevation, max(CASE WHEN p.Name = 'GrossHeight' THEN TRY_CAST(p.Value AS DOUBLE) END) AS GrossHeight, max(CASE WHEN p.Name = 'GrossFloorArea' THEN TRY_CAST(p.Value AS DOUBLE) END) AS GrossFloorArea FROM EntityText e LEFT JOIN ParameterText p ON p.EntityIndex = e.EntityIndex WHERE e.Category = 'IFCBUILDINGSTOREY' GROUP BY e.Name ORDER BY Elevation
